notes: Corvid 44 is an 8-lane PCIe 2.0 capture/playback card (no rack units — internal card, not rack-mountable), powered entirely from the PCIe slot (17W typical/19W max) with no external power connector, so no power port is listed. All video/reference connectors on the card bracket are DIN 1.0/2.3 miniature coax (not full-size BNC); AJA supplies a breakout cable terminating in standard BNC connectors — "bnc" was used as the closest connector id per instructions. AJA also sells "Corvid 44 BNC" and "Corvid 44 12G"/"Corvid 44 12G BNC" variants (full-size BNC bracket, and 12G-SDI versions respectively) — this entry is for the base 3G-SDI "Corvid 44" model. Could not directly confirm from primary source whether the Reference/LTC input connector is DIN 1.0/2.3 or a separate style, or the exact RS-422 connector shape (assumed DB9, AJA's standard) — inferred from AJA's consistent hardware conventions across the Corvid/KONA line, not explicitly stated on the spec page fetched.

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: Card bracket uses a DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax connector (not full-size BNC); AJA ships a breakout cable to standard BNC. Software-configurable as input or output; supports 3G/1.5G/270Mb SDI (SMPTE 425/292M/259M-C).

ports.name: SDI 2
ports.note: DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax on bracket, BNC via breakout cable. Configurable as input or output.

ports.name: SDI 3
ports.note: DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax on bracket, BNC via breakout cable. Configurable as input or output.

ports.name: SDI 4
ports.note: DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax on bracket, BNC via breakout cable. Configurable as input or output.

ports.name: Ref/LTC In
ports.note: DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax on bracket (BNC via breakout cable); switchable Analog Color Black or HD Tri-level sync reference, or LTC timecode input. A second internal LTC input header also exists (not an external port).

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: External connector present on the full-height bracket variant for frame-accurate deck/device control; on the low-profile card it is only an internal header, not an external port.
